test_title: SSC GD Constable Previous Year Paper (Held on: 14th December 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence. If there is no need to substitute it, select ‘No substitution required’.

__Lot of people__ want to go on the excursion.
solution:
The correct answer is **" lots of people".**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **A lot **means a set of people or things in excess
 
• ** "A lot" **is generally used when we emphasize something that is present in excess amount.
 
 
• **Example -** I* have a lot of money.*
 
• A lot is used as an **adverb.**
 
 

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**​

 
• A lot of and lots of are used with countable and uncountable nouns.
 
• These can be used with singular and plural nouns.​
 
 
• **Example - ***A lot of milk is in the glass. (Singular)*
 
• **Example -*** Lots of tables are needed at a party. (Plural)​*
 
 

1ee:T8
